Name: The Wizard Howl
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
If you're like me, you like your wizards young, hot, and voiced by Christian Bale. This mod will turn the Wizard into Howl from Howl's Moving Castle! (In appearance only, not by name, sorry)

This mod currently includes compatibility for:

-1.6 Vanilla
-SVE
-Seasonal Cute
-Seasonal Cute SVE 
-RRRR

[b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b]

[b]For Vanilla:[/b]
-Download file
-Drop Vanilla Wizard Howl into Mod folder
-Done!

[b]For SVE:
[/b]-Download file
-Overwrite Stardew Valley Expanded with the included Stardew Valley Expanded file
-Done!

[b]For Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic:
[/b]-Download file
-Overwrite [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters with the included [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters file

[b]For Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE:
[/b]-Download file
-Overwrite [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE with the included [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE file
-Done!

[b]For RRRR:
[/b]-Download file
-Overwrite Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp with the included Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamp file
-Install the [CP] Howl RRRR file into your mod folder (this is configurable to seasonal outfits in GMCM)
-Done!

Enjoy!
